- **self**: Ollama client libraries: ollama-python / ollama-js / Go api package (11/5)

## Definitions

- [statement] The Go client is the `api` package inside the main `github.com/ollama/ollama` module, not a separate module. `api.ClientFromEnvironment()` reads OLLAMA_HOST; `Generate` and `Chat` stream to a callback. The ollama CLI itself uses this package. (high confidence) — https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/ollama/ollama/api · keywords: Ollama client libraries: ollama-python / ollama-js / Go api package · also: https://www.glukhov.org/post/2025/10/using-ollama-in-go/

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Antipattern: sharing one ollama-js client across streams you want to cancel independently; `abort()` kills every stream on the client, and a user issue requests built-in timeout cancellation and better error categories. (low confidence) — https://github.com/ollama/ollama-js/issues/92 · keywords: Ollama client libraries: ollama-python / ollama-js / Go api package

## Facts and statements

- [statement] ollama-python installs with `pip install ollama`, supports Python 3.8+, and offers a sync `Client` and an `AsyncClient`; extra keyword arguments are passed through to httpx, and `stream=True` returns a generator (async generator for AsyncClient). (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://github.com/ollama/ollama-python · keywords: Ollama client libraries: ollama-python / ollama-js / Go api package · also: https://pypi.org/project/ollama/
- [statement] PyPI lists ollama 0.6.3 (released 2026-09-29) as the latest Python client version. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://pypi.org/project/ollama/ · keywords: Ollama client libraries: ollama-python / ollama-js / Go api package
- [statement] ollama-js installs with `npm i ollama`; Node uses `import ollama from 'ollama'` and browsers use `import ollama from 'ollama/browser'`. A custom `new Ollama({host, fetch, headers})` replaces the default host http://127.0.0.1:11434. (medium confidence) — https://github.com/ollama/ollama-js · keywords: Ollama client libraries: ollama-python / ollama-js / Go api package · also: https://github.com/ollama/ollama-js/issues/92
- [statement] ollama-js supports tools (`tools`, `tool_name` for results), `think` (boolean or level), `webSearch`/`webFetch` (need an Ollama account and API key), and `abort()`, which cancels all streams on that client; for per-stream cancellation use one client per stream. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://github.com/ollama/ollama-js · keywords: Ollama client libraries: ollama-python / ollama-js / Go api package · also: https://github.com/ollama/ollama-js/issues/92
- [statement] The Go api package exposes Pull, Push, Create, Copy, Delete, List, Show, ListRunning, Version, Heartbeat, Embed, Whoami and Signout; web fetch/search, cloud status, model recommendations and SystemOne are marked Experimental, so their signatures may change. pkg.go.dev showed v0.40.4 (2026-10-13) with a note that it was not the module's latest tag. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-13) — https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/ollama/ollama/api · keywords: Ollama client libraries: ollama-python / ollama-js / Go api package
- [statement] Both Python and JS clients can use Ollama cloud models two ways: through a local Ollama after `ollama signin`, or directly by setting host to https://ollama.com with an OLLAMA_API_KEY bearer token. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://github.com/ollama/ollama-python · keywords: Ollama client libraries: ollama-python / ollama-js / Go api package · also: https://github.com/ollama/ollama-js
- [statement] A newer System One endpoint (structured multiple-choice, yes/no, scored answers) appears in all three clients and needs Ollama server v0.35.0+; in ollama-js it needs a compatible model and does not support streaming or cloud models. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://github.com/ollama/ollama-python · keywords: Ollama client libraries: ollama-python / ollama-js / Go api package · also: https://github.com/ollama/ollama-js, https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/ollama/ollama/api
- [statement] For production Go code an independent write-up (Oct 2025) recommends the official api package; LangChainGo suits chain/RAG pipelines, and community clients vary in coverage. Thinking-model quirks (GPT-OSS not disabling thinking, interleaved reasoning in streams) apply regardless of client. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-10-01) — https://www.glukhov.org/post/2025/10/using-ollama-in-go/ · keywords: Ollama client libraries: ollama-python / ollama-js / Go api package
- [statement] Third-party wrapper check: ai-sdk-ollama, a community Vercel AI SDK provider by a non-Ollama author, states it is 'built on the official `ollama` package' (ollama-js), accepts an existing Ollama client instance, and adds tool-call follow-up text, JSON repair and web search/fetch tools needing OLLAMA_API_KEY. Each major version targets one AI SDK major (4.x targets ai@^7, 3.x ai@^6 maintenance only, 2.x unmaintained). (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/ai-sdk-ollama@4.1.0/README.md · keywords: Ollama client libraries: ollama-python / ollama-js / Go api package
